pcvs.expression: int(self.batch_update_builder.batch_changed)

pcvs.expression: len(self.batch_update_builder.added) + len(self.batch_update_builder.removed) + len(self.batch_update_builder.moved) + (self.num_reqs if self.batch_update_builder.batch_changed and (not self.no_penalties) else 0)

pcvs.name: metadata_work_units
pcvs.rationale: Combines metadata setup, tensor copies, and penalty prompt construction into approximate work units, freeing features for processor transitions.

pcvs.expression: int(len([ids for ids in self.req_output_token_ids if ids is not None and len(ids) <= 1]) > 0)
pcvs.name: minimum_token_transition

pcvs.expression: len(self.batch_update_builder.added) + int(bool(self.batch_update_builder.added))
